rationale: It is the immutable, deterministic initial wave partition that assigns concrete shard sets before controller execution. The `initial` distinction matters because later recovery scheduling is mutable controller behavior, not part of the plan.
alternatives: rename to `waves` (loses the distinction from recovery-created scheduling)
derive from `runs` (would discard the declared deterministic shard grouping)
remove (would force the controller to invent initial scheduling)
simplestChoice: Keep `initial_waves` as the plan-owned list of initial shard groups.
